useWhen: Use SPELL when the source is a spell description: a level and school line, casting time, range, components and duration. A cantrip is a spell of level 0.
smallest: `ITEM.Name` (the name), `ITEM.Level` (0 to 9; 0 is a cantrip), `ITEM.School` (three-letter id), `ACTIVATION.Type` (the casting time unit). Without `RANGE` the importer stores range units `ft` with no value, and without `DURATION` it stores `inst`, so write both for a real spell.
notFor: A spell scroll: CONSUMABLE (`Consumable Type: scroll`).
A magic item that casts a spell (wand, staff, ring): EQUIPMENT or WEAPON, with the spell named in the description.
A class feature, feat, invocation, maneuver or psionic power with no spell level and school: FEAT.
A monster trait or action, even a magical one (breath weapon, innate ability): FEAT.

sourceRows.says: "Casting Time: 1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack"
sourceRows.write: `ACTIVATION.Type: reaction`; `ACTIVATION.Value: 1`; `ACTIVATION.Condition: "which you take when you are hit by an attack"`

sourceRows.says: "Components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)"
sourceRows.write: `COMPONENTS.Vocal: true`; `COMPONENTS.Somatic: true`; `COMPONENTS.Material: true`; `COMPONENTS.Ritual: false`; `MATERIALS.Value: "a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur"`; `MATERIALS.Consumed: false`

sourceRows.says: "M (a diamond worth 300+ gp, which the spell consumes)"
sourceRows.write: `COMPONENTS.Material: true`; `MATERIALS.Value: "a diamond worth 300+ gp, which the spell consumes"`; `MATERIALS.Cost: 300`; `MATERIALS.Consumed: true`

sourceRows.says: "(ritual)" after the school, or "Casting Time: 1 action or Ritual"
"one creature you can see within range"
"you can cast it once without a spell slot" and "you regain the ability when you finish a long rest"
sourceRows.write: `PREPARATION.Method: innate`; `USAGE.Uses Spent: 0`; `USAGE.Uses Max: 1`; `RECOVERY: [{Period: lr, Type: recoverAll}]`

checks: `ITEM.School` is a three-letter id: `abj`, `con`, `div`, `enc`, `evo`, `ill`, `nec` or `trs`. `evocation` fails. `ITEM.Level` is a number from 0 to 9. A cantrip is `0`; `cantrip` or `3rd` fails.
V is `COMPONENTS.Vocal`, not `Verbal`. Concentration is `DURATION.Concentration`, not a `COMPONENTS` key. The wrong key is ignored with a warning, so the spell loses that property.
A ritual spell is `COMPONENTS.Ritual: true` with `PREPARATION.Method: spell`. Do not write `Method: ritual` for it. `PREPARATION.Prepared` is `unprepared`, `prepared` or `always`.

`ACTIVATION.Type` is one id: `action`, `bonus`, `reaction`, `minute`, `hour`, `day` or `special`. `ACTIVATION.Value` is a whole number. "10 minutes" is `Type: minute` and `Value: 10`. `bonus action` fails.
Units are ids: `ft`, not `feet`; `minute`, not `minutes`; `inst`, not `instantaneous`. "Until dispelled" is `disp`. An unknown unit gives a warning.
"Self (15-foot cone)" is `RANGE.Units: self` plus an `AREA` section. Do not put the area size in `RANGE.Value`. Write `AREA` only when the spell has an area. A 2024 Emanation is `AREA.Shape: radius`.

The material text goes in `MATERIALS.Value`. A gp price goes in `MATERIALS.Cost` as a plain number: `300`, not `300 gp`. "Which the spell consumes" is `MATERIALS.Consumed: true`. Set `COMPONENTS.Material: true` as well.

A spell has no rarity, price, weight, quantity or attunement. `ITEM.Rarities`, `INVENTORY`, `COST_AND_WEIGHT`, `UNIDENTIFIED_DESCRIPTION` and `ATTUNEMENT` are ignored with a warning. Leave `USAGE` and `RECOVERY` out for a spell that is cast with spell slots.
